title: Turbulent Times Call For Experimental Law | NOEMA
gist: Joe Mathews argues accelerating climate, biological and AI uncertainty is pushing governments toward 'experimental law' — time-limited, bounded, evaluated legal exemptions — with Germany (drone, housing and autonomous-bus sandboxes), Singapore, China and India as leaders. Europe's AI sandbox mandate under the AI Act is stalling, delayed to August 2027, leaving AI largely unregulated in practice, while Germany's new Federal Proving Act tries to curb regulatory-capture fears with mandatory transparency.
